items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And Sonny Greer, nobody talks about him, but Sonny Greer had the theory... [INTERVIEWEE] That’s true.

ctx.x: For all the reeds. [scats] They was like swinging. [scats] And Sonny Greer, nobody talks about him, but Sonny Greer had the theory, he had the theory that he said, somebody said to him, “How, what is the job of a drummer with the band.” Sonny said, “To try not to get in the way.”

items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: I played with all them guys.
